executor_contract.interface: Registry.execute: executor(request, skills); native adapters: executor(prompt, workspace, *, options); reviewer(prompt); validator(candidate) or validator(base,candidate,outcomes)
inputs: reviewer(prompt: str) -> strict JSON text for review_skill
optional review executor(prompt, workspace, *, options) -> str for review_with_codex
ordinary checker(response: str, workspace: Path) -> Iterable[Check]; no checker means unverified outcome
outputs: Executor return value is returned unchanged; exceptions propagate. No outcome verification implied.
Review returns inactive proposal or no_change; no validation or activation implied.

shared_file_changes: Proposed only: add senai skills dispatch to senai.skills.cli.main.
Proposed only: add explicit registry-skill context option/hook without replacing native --skill or Telegram shared-session handling.
Proposed only: consolidate PyYAML==6.0.3 into shared packaging.
User-approved exception already applied: coordinator README byte-identical to main; no feature code or other shared file edits. See handoff.md for exact interfaces.

limitations: Coordinator normal CLI/Telegram production wiring not applied. Reviewer/learning acceptance explicit, not automatic.
Trusted caller supplies checks; status does not authenticate evidence.
Bounded YAML subset; Hermes metadata inert, no full runtime compatibility or source-folder/name conformance claim.
Live model checks passed only for the controlled CSV demo; normal production integration unverified.
Proposals modify SKILL.md only; supporting files preserved unchanged.
One controlled live correction/reuse passed; broad reviewer quality or general skill improvement unverified.
No-change review results are returned but do not have a separate durable attempt log.
Native Codex config/auth/tool settings apply; prompt/read-only mode are not independent tool isolation.
Runtime compatibility is checked only when caller injects compatibility_check; allowed-tools grants no permissions.
Obsidian projection is one-way and refreshed explicitly; edited managed pages are protected rather than overwritten. Windows-local destination avoids user-observed UNC EISDIR.

Public GitHub full SHA-1 commits only; no private/arbitrary URL/archive imports, automatic updates or security scanner. Per-request timeout/rate limits apply; whole-repo tree size can limit acquisition.
Ordinary runs standalone, not shared execution/session pipeline. File checks prove existence only; generated artifacts require explicit staged behavioral checks and acceptance to register as learned.
Learning cases establish only declared expected results; source-run reports/check adapters are trusted local state, not cryptographically authenticated proof or weight training.
